june12.claim_boundary: Descriptive named-unit dispatch/FCAS attribution only; no failure, availability, SOC, causal response, avoided-loss, or Hatta inference.

positive_control_2016.finding: AEMO reported Wivenhoe PS Unit 2 dispatch target reduced 250->40 MW and Delayed Raise availability increased 0->210 MW.
positive_control_2016.use: Demonstrates public named-unit target/FCAS attribution is possible when source evidence exists; not part of 2025 census.

claim_boundary: No inference of plant failure or non-availability from target/output mismatch alone.
No reservoir state or stored-energy sufficiency inference.
No E4 avoided economic loss inference.
